(AP Photo/Scott Marshall)APIf you purchase a product through a link on our site, we may receive compensation.By Tyler Kuehl | tkuehl@mlive.comThe Detroit Tigers get set to kick off a new season on Thursday afternoon, as they open up 2026 with the first game of a three-game set against the San Diego Padres.The Detroit Tigers are one of many teams that have high expectations heading into the new campaign. After making the playoffs in each of the past two years and making it all the way to Game 5 of the American League Divisional Series each time, some wonder if this is the year the Tigers finally get over the hump. All columns visible (no scrolling needed)They bring back two-time reigning American League Cy Young Award winner Tarik Skubal to the pitching staff that’s been bolstered by the likes of Framber Valdez and the return of Justin Verlander. The Tigers also have some heavy bats in their lineup, including familiar mainstays like Riley Greene, Kerry Carpenter, and Spencer Torkelson, as many hope that this team is good enough to make another run towards the playoffs. It might not be easy, as everyone now knows that the Tigers are not a team to be taken lightly. Many are picking the English D to finish atop the American League Central, which has some tough competition, but maybe not enough to hold off the Tigers.
